alt.en: A large gray conveyor stands between gray glasses on the left and a flat gray sheet on the right. Dotted gray lines connect the objects.
alt.zh: 一条大型灰色传送带居中，左侧是一副灰色眼镜，右侧是一张平放的灰色纸页；灰色点线连接着三个物件。

caption.en: Illustration: A conveyor represents the package supply chain, with glasses for inspection and a sheet for the advisory; it does not depict a tested deployment.
caption.zh: 示意图：传送带代表软件包供应链，眼镜代表检查，纸页代表安全通报；画面并未描绘经过测试的部署。
